Job Title: AI Senior Engineer
Years of Experience: 2 to 4
Location: Bangalore
Role Overview
We are looking for highly skilled and hands-on AI Engineers to design and build next-generation AI Agents for enterprise banking applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong software engineering fundamentals combined with practical experience in building AI-driven systems using modern language models, conversational AI, intelligent automation, and explainable AI techniques. This role requires engineers who can architect and implement enterprise-grade AI solutions not just experiment with theoretical AI concepts. Candidates must have real-world experience designing scalable, secure, explainable, and production-ready AI systems in regulated environments. The selected engineers will work on building intelligent banking agents capable of:
Conversational interactions
Observational and event-driven reasoning
Workflow orchestration
Decision support
Context-aware automation
Enterprise integrations
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop AI Agents for banking and financial services applications.
Build conversational AI systems for banking workflows.
Develop observational and autonomous agents capable of monitoring events, learning patterns, and triggering intelligent actions.
Design AI-powered enterprise software solutions with strong focus on scalability, explainability, auditability, and security.
Work with Small Language Models (SLMs) and enterprise-grade learning models for domain-specific banking use cases.
Build AI architectures that support human-in-the-loop workflows and responsible AI principles.
Integrate AI models with enterprise systems, APIs, workflow engines, databases, and banking platforms.
Collaborate with product managers, architects, domain experts, and engineering teams to deliver production-grade AI applications.
Implement model monitoring, evaluation, explainability, and governance mechanisms.
Optimize AI systems for latency, performance, accuracy, and cost efficiency.
Participate in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and proof-of-concept initiatives.
Required Skills & Experience
Core AI & Engineering Skills: Strong hands-on experience in designing and developing AI-powered applications. Experience with: Conversational AI AI Agents Autonomous/Observational Agents Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Prompt Engineering Agentic workflows AI orchestration frameworks. Practical experience working with: Small Language Models (SLMs) Large Language Models (LLMs) Fine-tuning and model optimization. Strong software engineering and system design capabilities. Experience building enterprise-grade distributed systems.
Programming & Technology Stack: Python, Java or Node.js, REST APIs and microservices, AI/ML frameworks and libraries, Vector databases and semantic search, Cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), Containerization and orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes).
AI Frameworks & Tools: LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, Hugging Face, Open-source model ecosystems.
Explainability & Responsible AI: Experience building explainable and auditable AI systems. Understanding of Explainable AI (XAI), AI governance, Responsible AI, Model evaluation frameworks, Bias mitigation, AI security and compliance.
Enterprise Experience: Experience delivering AI solutions in enterprise environments. Banking, fintech, or regulated industry experience preferred. Strong understanding of scalable architecture, security, compliance, and operational resilience.
Preferred Qualifications: Experience in banking or financial services domain. Exposure to loan processing, payments, treasury, risk, compliance, fraud detection, or customer servicing platforms. Experience integrating AI with enterprise banking software platforms. Familiarity with MLOps and AI lifecycle management. Exposure to knowledge graphs, intelligent workflows, or multi-agent systems. Understanding of data privacy and regulatory requirements in banking.
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, or related field.

AI Engineer

Location: Hyderabad Work Arrangement: Hybrid 3 days per week in the office

About the Role

Were looking for a hands-on AI Engineer who thrives on turning experimental AI workflows into reliable, production-grade services. In this role, youll own the end-to-end implementation of containerized Python services, document classification and extraction pipelines, and LLM-powered applications all built to meet defined reliability, latency, and cost constraints.

Youre someone who cares deeply about data quality, observability, and operability, and you bring the engineering discipline needed to make AI solutions safe, scalable, and trustworthy in production. If youre energized by closing the gap between AI experimentation and real-world impact, wed love to have you on the team.

Your Role Responsibilities Heres What Youll Do.
Automate manual workflows classification, extraction, and routing into reliable, production-grade services with clearly defined SLAs and SLOs.
Implement document classification and extraction pipelines (rules + ML/LLM-assisted) with human-in-the-loop patterns where needed, and maintain dataset hygiene including label validation, deduplication, schema enforcement, and drift checks.
Build containerized Python services (FastAPI/gRPC) with clean contracts: versioned endpoints, idempotency, retries, timeouts, and well-defined error taxonomies.
Define, test, and deploy Guardrails for LLM applications input/output validation, PII detection and redaction, and topic enforcement to ensure safety, compliance, and robust PII handling across data ingestion, processing, and model interaction layers.
Lead AI security initiatives: conduct Red Teaming exercises (prompt injection, jailbreaking, data exfiltration), integrate security telemetry with SIEM platforms, and harden pipelines against adversarial attacks.
Create evaluation harnesses including golden sets, negative tests, and regression gates, and instrument services with tracing, logging, and metrics using OpenTelemetry to ensure solutions remain safe, scalable, and reliable in production.
Technology Tools
Python
Docker
Kubernetes
FastAPI
gRPC
OpenTelemetry
Vector DB / Search Engine
OIDC / JWT
Guardrails Frameworks (e.g., NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, Llama Guard)
SIEM Platforms (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Sentinel)
Role Essentials
Bachelors degree or equivalent experience, with 2+ years of software engineering experience with Python and hands-on Docker usage.
Working knowledge of at least one retrieval stack (vector DB or search engine) and foundational exposure to Kubernetes.
Experience with data validation pipelines and familiarity with basic anomaly detection signals relevant to AI/ML workloads.
Proven ability to ship reliable AI-backed features with measurable quality gates, while reducing manual work through automation and maintaining rollback operability.
Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills with the ability to work effectively across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
What Wed Like to See
Comfort with modern API engineering and enterprise integration patterns, including authn/authz hooks (OIDC/JWT) and event-driven integration.
Experience producing well-documented interfaces clear docs, examples, and integration tests that enable consuming teams to move quickly and confidently.
Demonstrated experience operationalizing AI Guardrails, PII anonymization pipelines, and integrating AI security findings into centralized logging and SIEM systems.
Hands-on experience implementing human-in-the-loop patterns and evaluation harnesses for AI/ML pipelines.
Strong critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate high-level goals into new ideas and well-designed solutions.

Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including many of the Fortune 100, Hylands solutions create the foundation for a connected, agentic enterprise, where teams harness the power of AI to redefine how they operate and engage with those they serve.
